Sandbox_DazedPower_BankScale_tooltip: Scales how much every battery stores.
Sandbox_DazedPower_StormRate_tooltip: How often a thunderstorm trips an unprotected system's isolator. A grounding rod near the controller stops it. 0 turns lightning off.
Sandbox_DazedPower_HydrogenRisk_tooltip: A Makeshift bank charged hard in a closed room builds up gas. You are warned first; ignoring it can end in a fire.
Sandbox_DazedPower_AgeRate_tooltip: How fast charge cycles and running batteries flat wear cells for good. 100 is about 600 full cycles to lose a third of a cell; cheap chemistries suffer far sooner than sealed ones. 0 turns all battery wear off.
Sandbox_DazedPower_LinkRadius_tooltip: How far each component reaches to find the next one, in tiles. Banks chain, so a run of them can lead away from the controller. A transformer's power line runs two and a half times this far.
Sandbox_DazedPower_OutputScale_tooltip: Scales everything the panels make. 100 is the physical model.
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock: Who may pick up solar parts
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock_option3: Whoever placed it, their safehouse, admins and moderators
Sandbox_DazedPower_PickupLock_tooltip: Panels and battery banks are expensive to build and trivial to carry off. Mods that remove the tool requirement for moving furniture otherwise make every rig free to take. On a server this also decides who may use a rig's controls: switching a controller, its cables, wiring buildings, and a backup generator's switches and fuel barrels. Anyone nearby may still read the monitor, clean panels, and refuel or repair a backup.
Sandbox_DazedPower_RigChance_tooltip: On newly explored ground, one house in this many has a solar rig in the yard, and about one storage barn in an eighth as many holds a few spare panels and battery racks. 0 means none.
Sandbox_DazedPower_SimulateLoad_tooltip: Count what the lights, fridges and ovens in range are drawing. Off means the system only ever charges.
Sandbox_DazedPower_SnowRate_tooltip: How fast snow and dust cut panel output. 0 means neither builds up. Rain washes panels either way, and roof panels collect snow faster and shed it slower whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_DazedPower_TransformerLoss_toolt: What each transformer draws while the system has power, even with nothing switched on.
Sandbox_DazedPower_CableTilesPerWire_too: How many tiles of cable one Electric Wire covers. A 6-tile lead at 4 costs 2 wire. Cutting a cable gives half back. 0 makes cables free.
Sandbox_DazedPower_LiveShock: Shock when wiring a live system
Sandbox_DazedPower_LiveShock_tooltip: Running or cutting a cable while the controller is switched on can burn the player's hand. The chance grows with the system's load and falls with Electricity skill. Never lethal.
Sandbox_DazedPower_ColdStarts_tooltip: Below -5 C at the engine, a propane or petrol generator can fail to start, up to a 60%% chance at -25 C. Makeshift engines fail more often, Workshop ones less. Keep the engine warm or try again.
